stops.name: Küsnacht Goldbach
stops.note: ZSG's landing at Goldbach, used while Küsnacht can't be served. No boat stop in the national stop list, so the id is that of Küsnacht Goldbach railway station (8503141, about 300 m away); position from OpenStreetMap (node 6608734834, ZSG stop 'Goldbach').

changes.note: ZSG low-water timetable (zsg.ch/en/traffic-conditions/, PDF Niedrigwasser-Fahrplan_V7, valid from 19.10.26, no end date; read 2026-10-18). The Large Lake Cruise is a round trip from Bürkliplatz: 11:20 via Horgen, 13:20 via Meilen. Only the outward legs are in the public timetable; their returns (arriving Bürkliplatz 13:05 and 15:05) are not, so they can't be shown.

ZSG low-water timetable (as above): the Small lake cruise runs only Bürkliplatz - Kilchberg, daily 10:30, 11:30, 12:30, 14:30, 15:30, 16:30. The public timetable has 13:30 (Kurs 35) instead of 14:30 (Kurs 41), so 13:30 is withdrawn and 14:30 can't be shown.

ZSG low-water timetable (as above): Küsnacht and Erlenbach are not served; the Thalwil boat calls at Küsnacht Goldbach instead, at the times the public timetable gives for Küsnacht. Monday to Friday: every trip of the public timetable runs.

ZSG low-water timetable (as above): Küsnacht and Erlenbach are not served; the Thalwil boat calls at Küsnacht Goldbach instead, at the times the public timetable gives for Küsnacht. Saturday and Sunday: Thalwil 11:13-14:13 and Goldbach 10:28-14:28 hourly only; the later trips of the public timetable are withdrawn.
